earliestPhaseSemantics: The first phase in which the scenario is mandatory as part of its full gate. An independently runnable scenario may be activated earlier as an infrastructure smoke test.
phaseExecutionPolicy: Phase 4 activates exactly the 23 RUN rows whose earliestPhase is 4, retaining the Phase 3 DNS profile and requiring reviewed Phase 4 profiles for the other 22 rows. The 16 Phase 5 rows remain deferred and unprofiled.
